title: An instant and a timestamp convert at UTC by the epoch, with no session zone
verdict: make_timestamptz(epoch_us(ts)) and make_timestamp(epoch_us(x)) keep the microseconds under any TimeZone
description: `make_timestamptz(epoch_us(ts))` is the instant whose microseconds since 1970-01-01 00:00 UTC are the timestamp's wall-clock microseconds, and `make_timestamp(epoch_us(x))` is the naive timestamp of an instant's UTC wall clock. Neither reads `TimeZone` or needs ICU: the values at the ends of the reference's range (`0001-01-01` and `9999-12-31 23:59:59.999999`) and across a DST change come back unchanged under `Asia/Kolkata` and `America/New_York`; NULL stays NULL.

`ts AT TIME ZONE 'UTC'` gives the same instant, and `CAST(x AS TIMESTAMP)` of an instant, `x::DATE` and `CAST(ts AS TIMESTAMPTZ)` use the session zone (`duckdb-time-zones`): the writer uses the epoch spellings and the lift refuses the casts.
reference: `UnFn.atUtc` (D53) returns its argument: the microseconds are the same, only the kind changes. The writer spells it `make_timestamptz(epoch_us(ts))` and `make_timestamp(epoch_us(x))`, which read no zone.
